stories.title: Keralam government accused of centralising power
stories.summary: Opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan has accused the Keralam government of concentrating decision-making power within the Chief Minister’s office. He alleged that ministers are being kept in the dark about major department decisions, calling the situation unprecedented and demanding a judicial investigation into the administration. The government has not responded.

stories.title: Higher education minister discusses V-C appointments
stories.summary: Higher Education Minister P. Viswanathan said the government is in constant contact with the Governor to resolve differences regarding Vice-Chancellor appointments. The issue remains caught in litigation, though ministers and the Assembly Speaker have held recent talks to find common ground. The Governor has not commented on the progress.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav confirms Ayodhya visit
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav will visit the Ram Temple in Ayodhya on December 12. Dismissing BJP criticism that the trip is politically motivated, Yadav stated that God belongs to everyone. He also plans to visit Kedareshwar, Mathura and Vrindavan. The BJP has yet to adjust its stance.

stories.title: Mamata Banerjee skips traditional festivities
stories.summary: Former West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee did not observe Bhai Phonta this year, breaking a long-standing tradition of hosting party leaders at her residence. Her brother has reportedly joined a rival camp and praised opposition leader Suvendu Adhikari. The former Chief Minister has offered no public explanation.

stories.title: Ladakh prohibits protests during local elections
stories.summary: The Union Territory’s Chief Electoral Officer has prohibited all dharnas, protests and rallies within municipal limits of Leh and Kargil. The order remains in force until the local body elections conclude this month. Civil society groups had threatened to resume agitations to push for a list of demands.

stories.title: Sanjay Raut predicts NCP faction split
stories.summary: Shiv Sena MP Sanjay Raut claimed that 20 to 22 MLAs from the Sunetra Pawar-led NCP faction may break away soon. He suggested that recent meetings between NCP legislators and Sharad Pawar were not casual. The Sunetra Pawar faction has not confirmed any plans for a mass departure.

stories.title: Sunetra Pawar addresses NCP merger speculation
stories.summary: Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar declined to comment on reports of a potential merger between NCP factions. She stated that the matter will become clear in due course. The remarks follow a meeting between her son, Parth Pawar, and Sharad Pawar at his Mumbai residence earlier this week.

stories.title: Chief Minister Vijay holds closed-door meeting
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay chaired a closed-door meeting with TVK legislators at a luxury resort in Mahabalipuram. The session addressed party issues as the government marks six months in office. The meeting follows recent public criticism from the Opposition regarding the state's law and order situation.

stories.title: BJP to highlight SP stance on Ram Temple
stories.summary: The BJP plans to focus on the Samajwadi Party’s historical stance on the Ram Temple and the 1990 police firing in upcoming state polls. The SP has countered by alleging donation irregularities at the temple site. Both parties are preparing for a campaign centered on these long-standing grievances.

stories.title: Fadnavis defends UCC and NCP merger stance
stories.summary: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis defended the state's decision to draft a Uniform Civil Code, citing constitutional directives. Regarding the NCP merger speculation, he stated that the issue rests entirely with Sharad Pawar and Sunetra Pawar. The factions have yet to reach a formal agreement on the matter.

stories.title: Election Commission clarifies rules for retired officials
stories.summary: The Election Commission stated that retired government servants engaged by states are subject to Model Code of Conduct restrictions. These individuals cannot campaign or summon election officials for discussions during the code period. Violations will be viewed seriously, according to the commission's letter to various state chief secretaries.

stories.title: Sonia Gandhi writes on Nitish Kumar’s exit
stories.summary: In her memoir, Sonia Gandhi writes that Nitish Kumar’s 2024 exit from the INDIA bloc was planned. She recalls him walking out of a meeting with a feeble excuse before rejoining the NDA. The JD(U) has since hit back at the claims. The memoir is now available for purchase.

stories.title: Police investigate death in Baranagar flat
stories.summary: A 26-year-old woman was found dead in a locked Baranagar flat on Tuesday. Police suspect she was sexually assaulted before the murder. The victim had retrieved the keys from her brother-in-law shortly before the incident. An investigation is ongoing, and no arrests have been made at this time.

stories.title: Road accident kills bride-to-be and cousin
stories.summary: A bride-to-be and her cousin were killed after a speeding lorry struck their scooter near Deepanjali Metro station on Wednesday. The women were distributing wedding invitations when the accident occurred. The driver of the lorry has not been identified, and police are currently investigating the circumstances of the crash.

stories.title: Passenger dies after falling from bus
stories.summary: A 28-year-old woman died after falling from a moving bus in Adilabad district on Wednesday. She was travelling with her family when she fell near Junni crossroads. Doctors declared her dead upon arrival at the hospital. Officials are investigating whether the fall was accidental or a deliberate act.

stories.title: Train derails at Kanpur Central station
stories.summary: Four coaches of the Chauri Chaura Express derailed while departing Kanpur Central station on Wednesday evening. No injuries were reported among the passengers. Railway officials confirmed that one trolley from each of the four affected coaches went off the tracks. An inquiry into the cause is underway.

stories.title: Loco pilot struggles before train derailment
stories.summary: A video from inside the engine of the Sairang Express shows the loco pilot struggling with controls moments before the train derailed in Assam. The pilot is heard saying that nothing is working. Four passengers were injured in the incident. The railway authorities have launched a formal technical investigation.

stories.title: CRPF personnel injured in Kulgam attack
stories.summary: Three CRPF personnel were injured when suspected terrorists opened fire at a checkpoint in Kulgam on Wednesday. A search operation is currently underway to locate the attackers. The CRPF stated that the injured are receiving treatment. Security in the district has been heightened following the incident.

stories.title: Four-year-old boy dies in Delhi sewer accident
stories.summary: A four-year-old boy died after falling into an open sewer manhole in outer Delhi. Following a multi-agency search, the Delhi Jal Board confirmed the child's body was recovered at a water treatment plant. The remains were sent to a local hospital for preservation.

stories.title: Kolkata-Sairang Express derails in Assam
stories.summary: Six coaches of the Kolkata-Sairang Express derailed at Digaru station after the pilot lost control while yielding to another train. While railway officials stated all passengers were safe, the Chief Minister reported four injuries. Rescue operations are ongoing.

stories.title: Drone industry urged to reduce import reliance
stories.summary: The Drone Federation India says the sector remains vulnerable to supply disruptions due to its dependence on foreign motors, batteries, and flight controllers. The industry body is pushing for deeper localisation to mitigate risks from export restrictions and foreign reliance.

stories.title: Lam Research concludes semiconductor challenge
stories.summary: Lam Research hosted its annual advanced systems engineering competition for students from 190 colleges. More than 800 teams participated in the three-month event, which the company says highlights the skills required to design and optimise increasingly complex semiconductor manufacturing technologies.

stories.title: Research park planned for Perundurai
stories.summary: The Kongu Vellalar Institute of Technology Trust is developing a 14-storey research park in Perundurai. Promoters describe the 20,000 square foot facility as a knowledge hub designed to house satellite laboratories and foster product innovation. The foundation stone was laid by the Vice-President earlier this year.

stories.title: South Korean firms eye Tamil Nadu investments
stories.summary: Two South Korean automotive component manufacturers have submitted letters of intent to invest 1,370 crore rupees in Tamil Nadu. The companies, which supply Hyundai Motor India, are expected to sign formal agreements at an upcoming state government conclave.

stories.title: Electric motorcycle maker opens Chennai centre
stories.summary: Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay inaugurated a flagship experience centre for Raptee.HV in Chennai. The company, which received state financial support, aims to use the facility to demonstrate its electric car technology applied to two-wheelers and provide customers with an enhanced understanding of its products.

stories.title: Railway suppliers report loan disbursement delays
stories.summary: The Railway Equipment Suppliers Association says a shift to online registration for property deposits is stalling bank loans. The group claims several banks, including the Tamil Nadu Industrial Investment Corporation, have failed to update their software to support the state-mandated digital process.

stories.title: Guntur wins national cleanliness award
stories.summary: Guntur received the Super Swachh League award after ranking third among cities with populations between three and ten lakh. The city was recognised during the Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 ceremony in New Delhi, where Andhra Pradesh secured six national awards in total.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai ranked India's cleanest city
stories.summary: Navi Mumbai has been named the cleanest city in India, followed by Surat and Vijayawada. Indore, which held the top spot for eight years, did not rank among the leaders this year. President Droupadi Murmu presented the awards at a ceremony in New Delhi.

stories.title: Maharashtra beaches receive Blue Flag status
stories.summary: Three beaches in Maharashtra have secured international Blue Flag certification for the 2026-27 season. The state environment department stated the sites met standards for water quality, biodiversity protection, and sustainable tourism management. This is the first time beaches from the state have received the recognition.

stories.title: Bengaluru removes 150 tonnes of market waste
stories.summary: The Bengaluru Central City Corporation cleared 150 tonnes of waste from K.R. Market following a four-day cleaning drive during the Deepavali festival. The operation involved sanitary workers and marshals clearing festive debris, with the daily volume of waste peaking on the third day.

stories.title: GAIL proposes Bengaluru waste-to-biogas plant
stories.summary: GAIL has proposed a 123-crore rupee facility to convert 300 tonnes of daily organic waste into compressed biogas. The project, planned for the Karnataka Compost Development Corporation site, aims to produce clean fuel for distribution through the company's gas subsidiary.

stories.title: Gurugram bans coal and wood tandoors
stories.summary: Gurugram has prohibited the use of coal and wood as fuel in hotel and restaurant tandoors to combat air pollution. Under revised Graded Response Action Plan norms, eateries are now restricted to using electricity, gas, or other approved clean fuels.

stories.title: Firecrackers linked to Delhi air pollution spike
stories.summary: A study by the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology claims firecrackers were responsible for 71 percent of PM2.5 pollution in Delhi on Diwali night. The assessment found the contribution of fireworks significantly increased after midnight as the city's air quality deteriorated.

stories.title: Farm fires in Punjab and Haryana hit seasonal high
stories.summary: Farm fires in Punjab and Haryana reached their highest count of the season on Diwali. New estimates suggest the total reached 34,000 by November 9, far exceeding official counts. Winds carrying smoke toward Delhi are forecast to return Wednesday and Thursday. The air is expected to worsen again.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai named India's cleanest city
stories.summary: Navi Mumbai took the top spot in the 10th annual Swachh Survekshan cleanliness survey, ending Indore's eight-year streak. Surat and Vijayawada followed in second and third place. Madhya Pradesh led the states with nine national awards. Indore has been displaced from the top of the list.

stories.title: Missing data may have masked Diwali pollution
stories.summary: Missing PM2.5 data from monitoring stations could have raised Delhi's average pollution level by 49% on Diwali, according to the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air. If missing readings were 1,000 micrograms per cubic metre, levels would have hit 400. The air quality remains a measurement.

stories.title: Italy evacuates schools following bomb threats
stories.summary: Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools on Wednesday after receiving emailed bomb threats. Similar threats were reported in Ireland and Scotland. Premier Giorgia Meloni stated there was no indication of concrete danger, suggesting the emails aimed to generate alarm. The threats included a message directed at the Premier.

stories.title: US House blocks impeachment bid against Hegseth
stories.summary: The US House voted 211 to 204 to send impeachment articles against Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth to the Judiciary Committee, stalling a final vote. Republicans closed ranks to block the immediate effort. The Pentagon chief remains in his position while the committee reviews the articles of impeachment.

stories.title: Tanker carrying Indian crew hit in Persian Gulf
stories.summary: The Liberian-flagged tanker MT Fujairah Energy was struck by a projectile in the Persian Gulf on Tuesday. One Indian national was among four injured crew members. The government stated the remaining 18 crew, including five other Indians, are safe. The situation is currently being monitored by authorities.

stories.title: India objects to Chinese influencers filming in Bangladesh
stories.summary: New Delhi has requested action from Beijing and Dhaka after reports of Chinese influencers filming in Bangladesh and presenting the footage as India. The government described the videos as a distorted picture of the country. Reports indicate a campaign of filming in impoverished neighbourhoods to create false narratives.

stories.title: India discusses food corridors with Russia and Ukraine
stories.summary: India has exchanged ideas with Russia and Ukraine regarding food corridors to facilitate grain exports from Black Sea ports. The proposal is part of a broader ceasefire effort. The external affairs ministry confirmed India is working with stakeholders to support the return of peace in the region.

stories.title: Travel document required for Hasina return
stories.summary: The external affairs ministry stated that former prime minister Sheikh Hasina will require a travel document to return to Bangladesh. India declined to comment on her reported request for a passport from the Bangladesh high commission. Hasina has lived in self-imposed exile in India since August.

stories.title: India condemns false narratives in Chinese vlogs
stories.summary: India has formally objected to reports of Chinese influencers filming in Bangladesh and misrepresenting the locations as Delhi. The government called for authorities in Beijing and Dhaka to address the peddling of false narratives. The content allegedly aims to present a distorted picture of India.

stories.title: Iran unveils underground missile facility
stories.summary: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps unveiled an underground complex described as a missile city during its Aerospace Week. The facility stores ballistic and cruise missiles in tunnels. Military leadership warned that American forces across the Middle East could be targeted if conflict with the US resumes.

stories.title: Cochin Shipyard develops hybrid welding technology
stories.summary: Cochin Shipyard and SFO Technologies have unveiled an indigenously designed hybrid laser arc welding technology. The system integrates laser and arc welding with robotics and automation. The companies claim the technology is the first of its kind to be designed and manufactured within the country.

stories.title: India and France hold economic security dialogue
stories.summary: India and France held inaugural talks in Paris on economic security, space, and critical technologies. The sides discussed supply chain vulnerabilities and cybersecurity. The dialogue was established in June 2026 during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to France. Strategic supplies were a primary focus of the meeting.

stories.title: India and Norway explore waste-to-resource technology
stories.summary: India and Norway are researching technology to convert industrial and construction waste into sustainable building materials. The initiative follows the elevation of relations to a Green Strategic Partnership. The project focuses on hazardous waste treatment and the circular economy within the cement and construction sectors.

stories.title: CRPF to acquire kamikaze drones
stories.summary: The Central Reserve Police Force is seeking to acquire kamikaze drones for anti-insurgency operations. Requirements include a 15-kilometre range and two high-explosive warheads. These loitering munitions are designed to destroy themselves upon impact with a target. The force is currently reviewing potential supplier products.

stories.title: India calls for climate finance at COP31
stories.summary: India urged developed nations to fulfill finance obligations under the Paris Agreement during the COP31 summit in Türkiye. The government stated that public funding must remain central to climate action in developing nations. India emphasised that no country should be left behind in collective climate efforts.

stories.title: Climate cooperation remains a challenge at COP31
stories.summary: The US midterms have opened the door to potential climate cooperation, though global institutions remain strained by tariffs and conflict. Navtej Sarna notes that while it is profitable to ignore climate change, performative grandstanding often dominates summits like COP31. The landscape of discontent remains crowded.

stories.title: UN chief warns climate crisis is outrunning humanity
stories.summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned leaders at COP31 that the climate crisis is outrunning global efforts. He described the current path as one toward mutually assured destruction, citing rising emissions and temperatures. Guterres urged nations to fight harder rather than surrender to the climate reality.

stories.title: Kerala High Court sets deadline for mental health centre upgrades
stories.summary: The Kerala High Court has ordered the government to provide adequate medicines and vehicles at mental health centres by November 24. Justices Devan Ramachandran and Basant Balaji stated that assurances are insufficient and must translate into action. The court also expects a report on pending infrastructure repairs.

stories.title: Firecracker injuries surge in Bengaluru during Deepavali
stories.summary: Over 200 people in Bengaluru suffered firecracker-related injuries during Deepavali, including toddlers and elderly residents. Many victims were bystanders, and seven patients were admitted to the Victoria Hospital with significant burns. The festival of lights left some with permanent vision loss and critical injuries.

stories.title: Congress delegation visits LNJP Hospital over pollution concerns
stories.summary: A Congress delegation led by Devender Yadav visited LNJP Hospital to highlight a rise in respiratory ailments. The party accused the BJP government of failing to implement adequate measures to control pollution in the national capital. The situation has reportedly worsened since the recent Diwali festival.

stories.title: Organ donors in state service may receive recovery leave
stories.summary: Health Minister K.G. Arunraj announced that state government employees who donate organs are likely to receive 42 days of leave to recuperate. The government also plans to prioritise organ donors if they require a transplant. Officials urged the public to reduce alcohol consumption to improve liver health.

stories.title: ICAR scientist calls for stronger viral threat preparedness
stories.summary: Yashpal Singh Malik of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research has urged India to strengthen its preparedness against emerging viral threats. He advocated for advanced diagnostics, indigenous vaccine development and better surveillance. The call came during a national conference on viruses held in Thiruvananthapuram this week.

stories.title: Keralam to implement family sustainability mapping
stories.summary: The government will launch Family Sustainability Mapping to identify children in high-risk environments at an early stage. The decision follows the death of a child in Alappuzha due to suspected malnutrition. The assessment will involve schools, local government institutions and health departments to monitor family circumstances.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu publishes documentation of historic survey stations
stories.summary: The Department of Survey and Settlement and the State Department of Archaeology have published five volumes documenting Great Trigonometrical Survey stations. Launched in 1802 by Colonel William Lambton, the survey used theodolite instruments for 70 years. The stations remain under the jurisdiction of the Survey of India.

stories.title: IMD forecasts depression over Bay of Bengal
stories.summary: The India Meteorological Department expects a low-pressure area to form over the south-east Bay of Bengal by November 13. It is likely to intensify into a depression by November 15. No rainfall alerts have been issued for the state as weather experts monitor the cyclonic circulation.

stories.title: PK Mishra calls for granular climate risk data
stories.summary: Principal secretary to the Prime Minister PK Mishra has urged for the integration of administrative records and satellite imagery to improve climate risk anticipation. He told the EfD Network that India needs more granular, district-level data to better inform policymaking regarding food security and agricultural challenges.

stories.title: Recent road repairs on OMR fail to hold
stories.summary: Portions of Rajiv Gandhi Salai and the Medavakkam-Sholinganallur Road remain riddled with potholes despite recent repair attempts. Commuters report that the damaged sections, currently affected by Chennai Metro Rail works, cause significant traffic congestion. The Sholinganallur junction remains a particular point of difficulty for drivers.

stories.title: Rapido responds to passenger harassment allegation
stories.summary: A passenger alleged that a Rapido driver made inappropriate sexual remarks during a phone call. The company has responded to the viral post regarding the incident. The full details of the company's internal investigation and the specific actions taken remain available to subscribers of the original report.

stories.title: Fox on runway diverts IndiGo flight in Kolkata
stories.summary: An IndiGo flight was diverted just before landing at Kolkata airport after a fox was spotted on the runway. The presence of the animal forced the pilot to abort the landing. Further details regarding the airport's wildlife management protocols are available to subscribers of the original report.

stories.title: Minister faces ridicule over claim regarding Netanyahu
stories.summary: Minister K.M. Shaji claimed that Muslim Youth League workers from Kerala contributed to the political defeat of Benjamin Netanyahu in Israel. The statement drew widespread ridicule and memes on social media. The Minister made the remarks while addressing a youth wing meeting in Kochi earlier this week.

stories.title: Consumer court orders gym to refund member
stories.summary: The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission ordered a gym to refund a member who quit after the facility closed 15 minutes earlier than advertised. The gym must pay the refund plus compensation and litigation expenses. The commission ruled the gym failed to provide the promised service environment.
